description: The Statistical Office of the Republic of Serbia published results of the 2022 Census of Population, Households and Dwellings as bilingual Serbian and English Excel tables. Dwelling tables count dwellings and their floor space by availability of water supply and sewage disposal installations and by electric energy, piped gas and heating installations, split into occupied, unoccupied and occasionally used dwellings, for every city and municipality and by urban and other settlements. Building tables give residential buildings by number of dwellings, period of construction, number of floors and lift availability, and outer wall material; a settlement table gives the number and floor space of housing units for each settlement. Coverage is national: of 3,613,352 dwellings, 3,589,611 had electric energy installations, 404,405 were connected to piped gas and 1,829,990 had heating installations, of which 718,467 central heating. Format and access: free XLSX downloads without registration, plus a results database and visualisations. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the second heating column is footnoted and its English label should be checked against the Serbian. Simulation uses: municipal counts of dwellings on water, sewer, gas and central heat for network planning, and storeys, lifts and wall material for seismic exposure. Related records: the Croatia census 2021 housing installations and the Hungary census 2022 dwelling equipment series.
